summary: Bush-side verge on Fleming Road; homes 25-30 m across the road, narrow room.
reasons: Backs onto dense bush, no car park visible
Nearest homes 25 m, across the road
Narrow dirt verge, tight for a van

best_section.where: Bare dirt verge on the bush side of Fleming Road, about 15 m south of the pin

drivers.seclusion: Dense bushland behind; nearest dwellings 25 m and further across the road, but they look straight onto the verge.
drivers.access_and_room: No formed car park seen at the pin, which sits in trees; a bare dirt patch meets the road edge just south, but it is narrow with trees beside it.
drivers.traffic: Through street with passing cars; a few cars parked on the road to the north in 2022 imagery.
drivers.convention: Some roadside parking seen north of the pin; no signs or campers visible.

flags: Steep near pin: up to about 11% on the slope north of it
Overhead power line runs along the bush edge
Pin is in trees; mapped car park not visible from above
sun_shade: Tree shade from the bush on the east side, morning sun blocked; open to afternoon sun across the road.
cannot_judge: Whether the dirt patch is wide enough for a van
